text: “The Count is the vilest creature breathing! The Count is a miserable Spy——!” Before we could either of us say another word we were alarmed by a soft knocking at the door of the bedroom. I had not yet sat down, and I went first to see who it was. When I opened the door Madame Fosco confronted me with my handkerchief in her hand. “You dropped this downstairs, Miss Halcombe,” she said, “and I thought I could bring it to you, as I was passing by to my own room.” Her face, naturally pale, had turned to such a ghastly whiteness that I started at the sight of it.
